text:
Dana: Quick capture from OrchardHealth onboarding demo this AM, they paused user rollout. Two immediate asks: step-by-step SSO playbook for their security ops team, and a per-tenant model-override toggle in the console so product owners can test different model sizes. They also mentioned embeddings quality drifting on long-lived indexes.

Felix: Thanks Dana. Which is blocking renewal or just slowing adoption?

Dana: SSO playbook = blocking for core users (renewal risk if not resolved in 10 days). Model-override = high-touch enablement need (would boost adoption but not immediate blocker). Embedding drift = reduces feature quality but customer said they can tolerate for now.

Anya: For the model-override toggle, do they want per-route or per-tenant?

Dana: Per-tenant first  product owners want to flip between baseline and a smaller LLM for cost/perf experiments.

Ravi: I can own the SSO playbook. Need exact IdP screenshots and their SP metadata. Dana, can you upload the screenshots and the SAML metadata blob?

Dana: Uploaded to intake: https://redwood.internal/cs/orchard_onboard_3100. It includes Okta screenshots and a sample SSO error log.

OncallBot: Ticket created -> ORCH-1122: "SSO playbook + emergency enablement session" assigned to @Ravi.

Felix: Triage suggestion: SSO playbook P0 (renewal window), model-override toggle P1 (adoption uplift), embeddings drift monitoring P2 with suggested mitigation (auto-reindex TTL).

Anya: For toggle options: Option A = quick UI flag that maps tenant -> model_alias and routes it at the API gateway (2-3 dev days). Option B = persistent config + rollout UI + audit (5-7 days). A seems fast and safe as a feature flag.

Ravi: I'll schedule an enablement session for Wed 9am PT and draft the playbook this afternoon. Need Product to sign off on what we recommend for the UI toggle before presenting to customer.

Felix: I'll put the toggle proposal into PX-909 and attach Anya's estimates. Recommend Option A as a canary with audit logs.

Dana: Customer happy to accept a canary flag if it means earlier shipping. They also want a simple export of sampling examples from their embeddings index to validate drift — that could be a short-term diagnostic.

Anya: I can add an endpoint to sample N vectors + metadata for a tenant. Low effort (~1d) and will help CS/Customer validate drift. Marking that as P2 quick-win.

OncallBot: Note -> created product backlog tickets PX-909 (model-toggle), ORCH-1122 (SSO playbook), PX-910 (embedding-sampler). Follow-up reminders in 72h for PX-909 and ORCH-1122.

Felix: Action items summary:
- Ravi: SSO playbook + enablement session Wed 9am PT (P0)
- Anya: spike UI flag implementation + sample endpoint (P1 for flag, P2 for sampler)
- Felix: create PX-909 + attach estimates and recommended rollout (done)
- Dana: customer comms + attach any extra logs/screenshots (done)

Ravi: I'll post the draft playbook to ORCH-1122 and invite Orchard's security lead.

Dana: Thanks all. I'll include this thread in the weekly CS->Product rollup and ping if the customer escalates.

Felix: Good triage. Let's keep velocity high on SSO given the renewal timeline.

Anya: Will start the spike tomorrow and update PX-909 by EOD.

OncallBot: Reminder scheduled -> check ORCH-1122 in 3 days.
